title: Duel Decks: Nissa vs. Ob Nixilis: card flavor text
storyline: Duel Decks: Nissa vs. Ob Nixilis

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker elf who once chose fighters for the Joraga and now gathers forces to defend all of Zendikar.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A demon planeswalker who seeks revenge on Zendikar and boasts of conquering worlds.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A plane threatened by the Eldrazi and by Ob Nixilis's vengeance.

entities.name: Joraga
entities.description: An elven tribe Nissa once chose fighters to defend.

entities.name: Roil
entities.description: Zendikar's upheavals, mitigated by elven methods.

entities.name: Murasa
entities.description: Zendikar region whose jungles regrow after Eldrazi attacks.

entities.name: Desmera
entities.description: A ruler who blinded her seers so her beauty was their last memory.

entities.name: Drana, Kalastria Bloodchief
entities.description: A bloodchief who says the lost must first be freed from suffering.

entities.name: Radavi
entities.description: A Joraga relic hunter who spoke last words about curses.

entities.name: Berko
entities.description: A man who heard the swamp laughing as a bridge snapped.

events.summary: Ob Nixilis vows revenge on Zendikar one soul at a time.
events.quote: I will secure my revenge on Zendikar one soul at a time.

events.summary: Ob Nixilis speaks the word of Zendikar's doom.
events.quote: The doom of Zendikar was here at last.

events.summary: Nissa now gathers forces to defend all of Zendikar.
events.quote: Now, she gathers forces to defend all of Zendikar.

events.summary: Radavi died on a relic hunt, defying a curse.
events.quote: The worse the curse, the better the prize.

events.summary: A bridge snapped and Berko heard the swamp laughing at him.
events.quote: As the bridge snapped, Berko was sure he heard the swamp laughing at him.

relations.note: Nissa once selected fighters to defend the Joraga.
relations.quote: Once, Nissa selected worthy fighters to defend the Joraga.
I will secure my revenge on Zendikar one soul at a time.
